kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §6.1 L217: Tab from anywhere inside leaves the grid in one press to the next stop of its panel; the next panel's header when the grid is the panel's last stop; never one row

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Drawn: the ladder is the DOM panel's last stop, so Tab lands on the Positions header (reading order: Chart, DOM, Positions, Tape); the Positions panel now shows panel focus

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Shift+Tab from the ladder leaves to the previous stop, the DOM header (§6.1)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: QA-1 (hand-off §G): after one Tab, activeElement is outside the grid and is the panel's next stop

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Keyboard: Tab (one press) out; Shift+Tab back to the DOM header

value-1.chars: §6.3 L225: Esc closes the innermost transient first: an open menu, then an in-cell edit, then the selection (D04E11:296), then an expansion; only with nothing open does it leave the grid

value-2.chars: A panel-hosted grid (the ladder) exits to its panel header: the RG-08 toolbar's last-focused item, else its first (D15:269). Drawn: the first tool

value-3.chars: SCR-045 keeps its merged destination, the plot stop (D04-C2); not drawn here

value-4.chars: A bare Esc never cancels an order in any grid; Ctrl+Delete cancels a focused order (D04-C3)

value-5.chars: QA-1 (hand-off §G): after Esc with nothing open, focus is in the panel header's toolbar

value-6.chars: Keyboard: Esc peels menu → edit → selection → expansion → header
